scope: Additive paired NE-DET official-final inventory after the official NFL gamebook became available. Binds New England 10, Detroit 35; audits the complete printed starter, substitution, DNP, inactive, quarterback, specialist and play-level injury-status record; preserves the immutable issued DET +3 prediction; and records the exact remaining source/method gates. This is not a numerical completion and changes no carried rating, QB production input, fair, terminal or completed baseline receipt.
estimationPolicy: Factual preparation only. Missing phase exposure, exact unprinted injury boundaries, replacement allocation and locked values are not zero. Current-week labelled estimates are retained as pregame evidence but are not silently rebound as completed historical learning. No new numerical method is authorized.

sources.finding: Complete 16-page official NFL gamebook records New England 10, Detroit 35; both teams' starters, substitutions, blank DNP sections and final inactives; full play-by-play and printed injury/status notices; individual and team statistics; quarterback duty; and specialist duty. It does not contain per-player offense, defense and special-teams snap tables.
